title: Elite League Round 1 of Finals. Maroussi top AO Triton for the title
description: Forward Nikolaos Kamarianos (204-1997) nailed a double-double by scoring 16 points, 11 rebounds and 4 assists for the winning side and point guard Pavlos Xydas (185-1993) accounted for 14 points and 6 assists. Maroussi's coach Giorgos Skarafingas allowed to play the deep bench players in such tough game. Center Panagiotis Tsamis (204-2002) came up with 15 points and 9 rebounds and guard Kostas Koufopoulos (187-1999) added 18 points and 4 assists respectively for AO Triton in the defeat. Four AO Triton players scored in double figures.
